CITY OF SOUTH PASADENA
  CITY COUNCIL CLOSED SESSION
  SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA

  Emergency Operations Center (EOC)
  South Pasadena Fire Department
  817 Mound Avenue, South Pasadena, CA 91030

  Tuesday, April 20, 2021, at 6:30 p.m.

  NOTICE ON PUBLIC PARTICIPATION & ACCESSIBILITY

 Pursuant to Section 3 of Executive Order N-29-20, issued by Governor Newsom on March 17,
 2020, the special Closed Session meeting of the City Council for April 20, 2021 will be conducted
 remotely and held by video conference.

 Please be advised that pursuant to the Executive Order, and to ensure the health and safety of the
 public by limiting human contact that could spread the COVID-19 virus, the Emergency Operations
 Center will not be open for the meeting. Council Members will be participating remotely and will
 not be physically present.

CALL TO ORDER:  Mayor Diana Mahmud
ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Jack Donovan, Jon Primuth, and Evelyn
  G. Zneimer; Mayor Pro Tem Michael Cacciotti and Mayor
  Diana Mahmud

 PUBLIC COMMENT AND SUGGESTIONS
 The City Council welcomes public input. If you would like to comment on an agenda item,
 members of the public may submit their comments for City Council consideration by one
 of the following options, for agenda items specified on this special agenda:

 Option 1:
 Dial (626) 322-2344 and leave a recording of your public comment. Please state your name
 and the specific special agenda item you are providing public comment for. Public
 comments will only be taken for items on the special agenda (no general public comment).
 The cutoff time for public comment to be submitted via phone recording is 4 p.m. the day
 of the Council meeting.

 Option 2:
 Email your public comments to ccpubliccomment@southpasadenaca.gov.  Public
 Comments received in writing will not be read aloud at the meeting. Written public

 comments will be announced at the meeting and become part of the meeting record. Written
 public comments will be uploaded online for public viewing under Additional Documents.
 There is no word limit on emailed Public Comment. Public comments will only be taken
 for items on the special agenda (no general public comment). Please make sure to indicate:
 1) your name, and 2) what special agenda item you are submitting public comment on.

 Pursuant to state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the
 meeting agenda, except that members of the City Council or staff may briefly respond to
 statements made or questions posed by persons exercising public testimony rights
 (Government Code Section 54954.2). Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

 CLOSED SESSION AGENDA ITEMS

A. PUBLIC EMPLOYMENT
  (Government Code Section 54957)

  Title: City Manager

 I declare under penalty of perjury that I posted this notice of agenda on the bulletin board in the courtyard of
 City Hall at 1414 Mission Street, South Pasadena, CA 91030, and on the City’s website as required by law.
  04/19/2021  /s/
